title: Local task orchestration driven by specifications

tasks.title: Create the specification and executable task graph
tasks.prompt: Validate the SDD artifacts for specification 001 and report missing requirements without modifying implementation files.
acceptance: All four SDD artifacts exist
The manifest parses and has an acyclic graph
tasks.verify: Inspect spec.md, decisions.md, tasks.md and tasks.json

tasks.title: Model executable tasks and persistence
tasks.prompt: Implement the domain and SQLite persistence required by specification 001 for tasks, dependencies, approvals, statuses, runs and events. Preserve existing behavior and add focused tests.
acceptance: Task, dependency, approval and lifecycle records persist
Invalid state transitions are rejected

tasks.title: Validate the executable task graph
tasks.prompt: Add JSON manifest loading and validation for required fields, duplicate ids, missing dependencies and dependency cycles, with focused tests.
acceptance: Duplicate ids, missing dependencies and cycles are rejected
A valid manifest produces ready and blocked tasks

tasks.title: Dispatch ready tasks through the local App Server
tasks.prompt: Implement the task coordinator that selects the assigned model and effort, starts or resumes a local App Server thread over stdio, executes ready tasks and persists route and run evidence.
acceptance: The assigned profile resolves to the declared model and effort
A ready task creates a thread and turn through stdio
tasks.evidence: El App Server local completó el thread y el turn asignados con el modelo y esfuerzo declarados; cargo test --workspace pasó con 28 pruebas y se persistieron route_id, run_id, thread_id, turn_id y eventos de protocolo.

tasks.title: Handle approvals, failures, recursion and resume
tasks.prompt: Complete the coordinator lifecycle for manual approvals, fail-closed errors, internal recursion protection and idempotent runId continuation.
acceptance: Approval gates prevent dispatch
Resume does not duplicate terminal events
Internal workers do not recurse
tasks.evidence: El App Server local ejecutó T-005 con aprobación explícita; se implementaron gates de denegación, continuación idempotente, evidencia transaccional y protección contra recursión. cargo test --workspace pasó con 40 pruebas.

tasks.title: Expose the coordinator through the CLI
tasks.prompt: Add neutral CLI commands for loading a spec, listing task status, approving a task, dispatching ready tasks and continuing a run by runId.
acceptance: The CLI validates a spec and dispatches only ready tasks
Status, approval and continuation commands expose persisted evidence
tasks.evidence: El App Server local ejecutó T-006 con aprobación explícita; se añadieron spec-load, task-list y task-dispatch, preservando gates y continuación. cargo test --workspace pasó con 44 pruebas.

tasks.title: Connect desktop prompts to task creation
tasks.prompt: Adapt the desktop prompt boundary so an incoming message can create or update a RouDex task without duplicate execution or bypassing the coordinator.
acceptance: A desktop prompt creates or updates a task
The original turn is not duplicated
Router failure blocks bypass
tasks.evidence: El App Server local ejecutó T-007 con aprobación explícita; el adaptador crea/actualiza tasks, deduplica entregas y bloquea fallos del router. cargo test --workspace pasó con 51 pruebas.

tasks.title: Expose local orchestration state in the UI
tasks.prompt: Connect the local Tauri/React interface to task, run, event, approval and error state without introducing remote services.
acceptance: The UI lists tasks, runs, events, approvals and errors
The UI remains local-only
tasks.evidence: El App Server local ejecutó T-008 con aprobación explícita; la UI Tauri/React lee tasks, runs, eventos, aprobaciones y errores en modo solo lectura local. cargo test --workspace pasó con 56 pruebas y el build frontend pasó.

tasks.title: Verify and publish the orchestration milestone
tasks.prompt: Run the full acceptance suite for specification 001, audit the task evidence and publish the milestone with signed commits, tag and release.
acceptance: Scenarios A1-A12 have evidence
The worktree and release audit pass
No secrets or local state are published
tasks.evidence: acceptance-evidence.md: 58 tests passed; T-001 historical assignment discrepancy and native UI smoke remain explicit. The coordinator completed the audit and the parent workflow published signed tag/release v0.5.0.
